title: Cattle Trail minor/supporting character record
description: Design-only content contract for non-romance-eligible characters: antagonists, family, townsfolk, spirits. Not consumed by current runtime. Lighter than companion.schema.json on purpose -- these characters do not have perks, recruitment, or a relationship arc.

category.description: Groups the roster for navigation as it grows. Pick the closest fit; do not add a new value without also re-grouping npcs.json by it.

location_ref.description: A location name from design/LOCATIONS.md or LORE.md's 'The country', or 'unplaced' if not yet tied to one.

hook.description: What this character is for -- the story or gameplay reason they exist. Not a quest; see design/LOCATIONS.md's rule that a location/character earns a room when something actually needs it.

voice_lines.description: Example lines only, written to LORE.md's style guide. Not wired to any banter file unless a continuity_note says so.

art_prompt.description: Art-direction comment for whoever paints this character later. Not a request to generate art now.
